title: The Deepest-Diving Mammal Stayed Under for 137 Minutes

scenes.text: The deepest diver among mammals isn't the biggest whale.
It's a Cuvier's beaked whale. One dove 9,816 feet, nearly two miles down.
And it stayed under for 137 minutes. Over two hours, on a single breath.
Scientists tagged eight of them off California and logged thousands of hours of dives.
That was a new record for any mammal.
The deepest diver on Earth is a whale you've probably never heard of.

description:
The deepest diver among mammals isn't the biggest whale.
A Cuvier's beaked whale dove 9,816 feet and stayed under for 137 minutes, a mammal record.
Could you hold your breath for even two minutes?
first_comment: Would you rather dive 2 miles down or hold your breath for 2 hours?
